description: This PHP source file defines the 'Information' class in the Opencart admin controller event namespace. The class manages event-driven tasks related to 'information' entities, such as adding, editing, and deleting information. Each method adds specific tasks to a task scheduler, signaling other parts of the system to perform operations asynchronously.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: The 'Information' class handles event-driven task scheduling for information entities within the Opencart admin system.

methods.name: addInformation
methods.description: Schedules tasks to generate new information data, triggered after adding new information.

methods.name: editInformation
methods.description: Schedules tasks to update information data, triggered after editing existing information.

methods.name: deleteInformation
methods.description: Schedules tasks to handle deletion of information data, triggered after deleting information.
